preservation: Before hashes capture the existing uncommitted working tree, including project consolidation and prior fixes. No Git reset, commit, force dependency downgrade, native platform folder generation, or user database access.

changes.honestUi: Removed nonfunctional ambience selector/dead styles and fabricated +trend/curve; current task completion is labelled factually.
changes.calendar: Dynamic four/five/six rows; 36 months checked for every date, unique cells, leap/year boundaries.
changes.prayer: Next/current selected from five displayed times using the supplied instant; after Fajr comes same-day Dhuhr. WIB/WITA/WIT boundary tests.
changes.deletion: Native Alert or browser confirmation explains subtask/priority/reminder deletion and preserved session history. Cancel does not mutate. Confirmed deletion survives a browser reload.
changes.alarm: Root after DB readiness resyncs latest committed tasks on launch/resume/calendar/restore. Native response/cold-start handler deduplicates and verifies task ID/occurrence/status. Foreground catch-up bounded to 24h; background stops audio and active return resumes a current real alarm. Scheduler warns on failures/permissions/exact alarm/partial coverage without failing committed data.
changes.alarmLimits: Song and alarm screen are in-app features; closed/background app uses OS notifications with tap to open. No custom full-screen wake/loop while killed guarantee. Managed nearest50 cap; calendar subtracts existing other notifications from its50 budget.
changes.media: Custom file copy must succeed; metadata save is atomic and fails honestly. Missing files fall back to built-in; playback failure reaches UI. JSON backup does not carry media bytes and restore explains choosing songs again.
changes.design: Current Sprout identity retained; DESIGN_V3 reconciled by component roles and exceptions.
changes.accessibility: 42 input names added (50 active inputs checked), 21 selected states added, contrast tokens adjusted, shared input48/textarea88 and key controls/hitSlop improved; header/label wrapping.
changes.layout: 88 current browser fixtures pass without measured horizontal overflow. Native keyboard/safe-area/TalkBack still open.
changes.web: Real Metro/Hosting COOP/COEP, await shared/retryable async worker bootstrap before synchronous Drizzle. Direct form entry fallback home. Timeline navigation separated from completion/play/delete to prevent nested buttons/hydration errors. Actual SQLite web CRUD/reload verified in a new Chromium context.

initialKnownAuditCounts.method: Observed initial npm audit full report; initial raw stream was not persisted.

dependencies.overrideCompatibility: Actual Minimatch constructor/match/negate/pattern and fingerprint ignore/directory helpers checked on Node22. Review/remove the override when upstream accepts a safe version; do not apply it globally.
